title: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity when sending nested Pydantic model
body:
When I send a POST request with a nested Pydantic model, FastAPI returns 422. Works fine with flat models. Python 3.11, FastAPI 0.104.

```python
class Inner(BaseModel):
    value: int

class Outer(BaseModel):
    inner: Inner
```

Request body: `{"inner": {"value": 1}}` → 422
author: dev_user_1

title: Same as #001 - nested model 422 error
body: I have the exact same issue as reported in #001. Nested Pydantic models return 422. Closing in favor of that issue.
author: another_user

title: np.array comparison with None raises FutureWarning
body:
Comparing a numpy array to None raises a FutureWarning in numpy 1.25+. This used to work silently.

```python
import numpy as np
arr = np.array([1, 2, 3])
result = arr == None  # FutureWarning
```

title: Memory leak when using WebSocket connections at scale
body:
Running 10,000 concurrent WebSocket connections causes memory usage to grow unboundedly. After 2 hours the process OOMs. Profiler shows FastAPI's connection manager retaining references after disconnect.

Reproduced on: FastAPI 0.103, uvicorn 0.24, Python 3.11, Linux

title: np.loadtxt fails silently on malformed CSV with mixed dtypes
body: When loading a CSV that has mixed integer and string columns, np.loadtxt silently skips rows instead of raising an error. Expected: ValueError. Got: partial array with no warning.

body: After upgrading FastAPI from 0.104 to 0.105, all my Depends() injections return None. Downgrading to 0.104 fixes it. No code changes on my end.
author: upgrade_victim

title: typo in docs: 'recieve' should be 'receive'
body: In the tutorial page on request bodies, there's a typo: 'recieve' should be 'receive'. Line 42 of docs/tutorial/body.md
author: grammar_police

title: SQL injection possible via unsanitized query parameter
body:
The example in the advanced tutorial passes user input directly to a raw SQL query without sanitization. While this is example code, it teaches bad practices and could be copy-pasted into production.

Affected file: docs/advanced/sql.md
author: security_researcher

title: np.fft.fft returns wrong results on odd-length arrays
body:
FFT on odd-length arrays gives incorrect output compared to scipy.fft and MATLAB. Even-length arrays are correct.

```python
import numpy as np
arr = np.array([1.0, 2.0, 3.0])
print(np.fft.fft(arr))  # wrong
```

title: Request body not validated when Content-Type header is missing
body: If a client sends a POST request without the Content-Type: application/json header, FastAPI skips validation entirely and passes None to the handler. Should raise 422.

title: Background tasks not executing when using TestClient
body:
BackgroundTasks don't run when using FastAPI's TestClient. They run fine in production with uvicorn. This makes testing background jobs impossible without spinning up a real server.

Reproducible with minimal example.

title: Same WebSocket memory leak as #005
body: Experiencing the same WebSocket memory leak described in issue #005. 10k connections, OOM after ~90 minutes.
author: ops_engineer

title: np.unique breaks on arrays containing NaN
body: np.unique treats each NaN as distinct, so an array with multiple NaN values returns multiple NaN entries. IEEE 754 says NaN != NaN but for a 'unique' operation this is counterintuitive and undocumented.
author: numerical_dev

title: Add GraphQL support
body: FastAPI should natively support GraphQL. Currently you have to use strawberry or graphene as separate packages. This should be built in.
author: graphql_advocate

title: CORS headers missing on 422 validation error responses
body:
When a request fails validation (422), the CORS headers configured via add_middleware(CORSMiddleware) are not included in the response. This causes browser clients to fail silently instead of showing the validation error.

FastAPI 0.104, Python 3.10
author: frontend_dev

title: np.histogram edge case with identical min/max values
body: When all values in an array are identical, np.histogram raises ValueError: max must be larger than min. Should return a valid histogram with all count in the first bin.
author: stats_user

title: Docs say to use `async def` everywhere but this tanks performance
body: The getting started guide recommends using async def for all route handlers. But if the handler does CPU-bound work, this blocks the event loop. The docs should clarify when to use def vs async def.
author: perf_engineer

title: Private API key visible in OpenAPI schema
body: When using APIKeyHeader as a security scheme, the example value in the auto-generated OpenAPI docs shows the literal string 'your-api-key-here' which could mislead developers. Worse, if someone misconfigures it, real keys could appear in the schema endpoint which is often publicly accessible.

title: Router prefix not applied to WebSocket routes
body:
When using APIRouter with a prefix, HTTP routes correctly get the prefix but WebSocket routes do not. Example: prefix='/ws' → HTTP routes get /ws/endpoint but WebSocket route stays at /endpoint.

FastAPI 0.103, Python 3.11. Minimal repro attached.
